text:
deploy-bot: [deploy:start] env=prod-us-west tag=release-1.6.2 commit=9f8b3a2 cause=canary-metrics
sasha: noticed canary P95 jumped ~1.2s after ~10k requests, suspect KV caching regression.
kyle: ack. pause rollout? request revert to previous stable if confirmed.
release-manager: we are within soft change window (22:00-02:00 UTC) — emergency rollback authorized.
oncall: paging infra-eng to sanity-check DB and cache layers.
infra-eng: no DB pressure, traces show a KV miss storm when shard count hits threshold; runtime shard eviction suspicious.
sasha: agree with rollback. i'll pin traffic to release-1.6.1 and trigger revert. @deploy-bot please run revert.
sasha: audit command:
```
deploy revert --env prod-us-west --to=release-1.6.1 --reason "canary latency spike" --force
```
ops-bot: @sasha initiating revert: release-1.6.1 -> prod-us-west (link: https://deployments.redwood.internal/ops/1912345678)
kyle: set fallback policy to tier2, disable cross-region spill for this rollout, and alert SLO owners.
release-manager: pin note: pin release-1.6.1 on prod routing tables; create ticket RB-412.
sasha: creating RB-412, tagging @oncall and @infra-eng with rollback steps and verification checklist.
oncall: muting noisy canary alerts for 10m during rollback :mute: — will re-enable after verification.
ops-bot: [deploy:progress] reverting services: api-gateway, runtime, cache-proxy (3/3)
infra-eng: please verify KV cache warmup and old ttl semantics after revert.
kyle: start perf smoke tests against a canary subset; monitor latency and error budget.
ops-bot: [deploy:complete] revert finished. env=prod-us-west to=release-1.6.1 commit=2a47c1b status=SUCCESS duration=4m12s
sasha: confirmed metrics: P95 returned to ~220ms over the last 30s. :tada:
release-manager: pinned release-1.6.1 across prod routing and documented RB-412. scheduling postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC — add logs and trace links to ticket.
kyle: note: block re-deploy of 1.6.2 until kv shard threshold fix; create hotfix branch from 1.6.1.
emily: creating hotfix branch hotfix/kv-shard-fix and PR https://git.redwood/internal/repo/pulls/2389
sasha: thanks everyone. monitors will stay open for 1h, then unmute alerts. any objections to closing this thread?
oncall: no objections, marking incident closed for now. follow-up PM and postmortem assigned.
ops-bot: [audit] rollback RB-412 recorded by sasha at 1912345678; related PR=2389; pin=release-1.6.1
kyle: added release notes entry: "rollback: reverted 1.6.2 due to KV caching regression causing elevated latency in canary; pinned 1.6.1"
release-manager: file updated. good job team. :thumbsup:
